articles.summary: Nordson Corporation (Nasdaq: NDSN) today announced that it has acquired Contrinex, a global technology leader in high-performance sensors supporting factory automation and related solutions. The acquisition complements Nordson’s test and inspection portfolio, adding leading technology in harsh-environment and miniature precision-positioning applications. “We are excited to welcome Contrinex’s nearly 500 employees into the Nordson family. Their differentiated sensor technology complements our test and inspection portfolio, particularly our growth focus on factory automation and control solutions,” said Srini Subramanian, executive vice president, Nordson Advanced Technology Solutions. “This acquisition signifies further progress on our Nordson Ascend Strategy to achieve top-tier growth through differentiated technologies with leading margins and returns. We look forward to applying the NBS Next growth framework and investing in Contrinex’s greatest opportunities for profitable growth,
articles.title: Nordson Corporation Completes Acquisition of Contrinex, Expanding Its Industrial Sensing and Automation Portfolio
